newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline soft and arbitrage seen closed.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline soft and arbitrage seen closed.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were softer on Friday and dealers said arbitrage opportunities to send more barrels westwards were closed.
Eurograde barge traded at $213 fob ARA but activity was thin.
Cargoes were notionally softer in line with barges and dealers assessed fob cargo prices around eight or nine dollars a tonne below fob barges.
Buying interest was patchy but one NWE refiner said he saw a little demand into Rotterdam to put barrels into storage, for release towards March or April.
